params.name: app_categories
params.description: A comma-separated list of app categories

params.name: hide_sidelined
params.description: only shows apps that have not been sidelined

params.name: app_license
params.description:
A comma-separated list of license types
 * FREE - Free app
 * PAID - Paid app
 * OPENSOURCE - Open source app
 * DEMO - Demo app

params.name: app_platform
params.description:
A comma-separated list of supported app platforms
 * 1 - Oculus Quest
 * 2 - Oculus Go
 * 3 - WebXR
 * 4 - Oculus Link
 * 5 - Other
 * 6 - Pico
 * 7 - Magic Leap

params.name: app_comfort_level
params.description:
A comma-separated list of comfort levels
 * 0 - Comfortable
 * 1 - Moderate
 * 2 - Average
 * 3 - Exciting
 * 4 - Intense

params.name: app_download_method
params.description:
A comma-separated list of download methods to query on
 * 1 - AppLab
 * 2 - Oculus Store
 * 3 - SideQuest, Itch, or other (requires sideloading)

params.name: app_ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of app ids

params.name: skip
params.description: Skips a number of objects from the start of the list.  Used for paging.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of objects returned.

params.name: staff_picks
params.description: Filters the returned rows by whether the app is selected as a staff pick.

params.name: supports_quest
params.description: Filters the returned rows by whether the app supports the Quest/Quest2.

params.name: supports_pico
params.description: Filters the returned rows by whether the app supports the Pico.

params.name: supports_magic_leap
params.description: Filters the returned rows by whether the app supports the Magic Leap.

params.name: is_webxr
params.description: Filters the returned rows by whether the app supports WebXR.

params.name: supports_link
params.description: Filters the returned rows by whether the app supports Oculus Link.

params.name: has_oculus_url
params.description: Filters the returned rows by whether the app has an Oculus URL and is an App Lab or Oculus Store app.

params.name: early_access
params.description: Filters the returned rows by whether the app is marked as early access.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filters the returned rows by those that have been updated after the provided unix UTC timestamp IN MILLISECONDS.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filters the returned rows by those that have created after the provided unix UTC timestamp IN MILLISECONDS.

params.name: search
params.description: Filters the returned rows by a search phrase to quickly find apps by name and search tags.

params.name: full_search
params.description: Filters the returned rows by a search phrase to search the name, search tags, summary and description for an app.

params.name: sortOn
params.description:
Sorts the returned object by one or more parameters.  Multiple values can be separated by a comma for sorting on multiple fields.
 * name - The app name
 * created - The app created date
 * updated - The last date the app was updated
 * sort_rating - A rating for apps
 * hot_sort_rating - A 'hot' rating for apps
 * early_access - Whether the app is early access or not
 * downloads - How many downloads the app has
 * search_rank - The search rank when 'search' is specified as a filter
 * full_search_rank - the search rank when 'full_search' is specified as a filter

params.name: descending
params.description: Orders the results in descending order based on the sortOn specified.  If there are multiple sortOns specified, multiple values can be separated by a comma for each corresponding sortOn.
